meta.name: get-unpublished-changes
meta.description: Compare HEAD with the latest published npm versions and list all unpublished changes by release layer. Triggers: unpublished changes, changelog, what changed, whats new.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对比本地代码与已发布版本，列出未发布的变更
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要知道哪些代码改动还没发布到npm
copy.tagline_en: Compare local code with published npm versions and list unpublished changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to know which code changes are not yet published to npm

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会对比本地代码与已发布的 npm 版本,逐条阅读实际改动,按三个发布层归类未发布的变更,并输出分层影响矩阵和版本升级建议。
howto.when: 当你说“unpublished changes”“changelog”“what changed”等,或询问最近有什么改动时触发。

say.text: 看看有哪些未发布的变更
say.note: Claude 会对比已发布版本并列出改动。

say.text: 按发布层分析未发布的更新,给出升级建议
say.note: 会输出分层影响矩阵和版本号建议。

say.text: 和已发布的 npm 版本比,这周改了什么
say.note: 会逐条阅读 diff 并解释真实改动。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude compares local code with the latest published npm versions, reads actual diffs, groups unpublished changes into three release layers, and outputs a layered impact matrix with version upgrade recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention 'unpublished changes', 'changelog', 'what changed', etc., or ask what has changed recently.

say_en.note: Claude compares against published versions and lists changes.

say_en.text: Analyze unpublished updates by release layer and suggest version bumps
say_en.note: Outputs layered impact matrix and version recommendations.

say_en.text: What changed compared with the latest npm release?
say_en.note: Reads diffs and explains real changes.
